主要内容: On June 11, 2012, Novavax, Inc. held its Annual Meeting of Stockholders, where Richard H. Douglas, Ph.D., Gary C. Evans, and John O. Marsh Jr., J.D. were elected as Class II directors to serve until the 2015 Annual Meeting. On June 15, 2012, shareholders voted on three proposals. They approved the selection of Grant Thornton LLP as the independent auditor for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2012, with 96,076,677 votes in favor. They also approved increasing the number of shares under the 2005 Stock Incentive Plan by 4,000,000, with 44,899,640 votes in favor.
